title: Pokemon SoulSilver (Japan)
budget: Existing functional/perceptual budget; preserve raw differences and require progression/save integrity and measured benefit.

patches.notes: Guarded regional port of the accepted 88-byte starter-idle gate. No scratch or new service. Explicit private catalog selection required. Native publications are not unique animation FPS or whole-game speed. Imported checkpoint provenance and bounded coverage are retained.

validated.static: Exact ROM/header/ARM9/stored and decoded overlay identity, expected bytes, relocated calls/layout and all 18 assets checked. Shared six-layout CPU contract reused.
validated.framebuffer: All 3600 idle screen pairs match original and unchanged decoded delivery.
validated.ram: Raw state/timing differences retained under the authorized functional budget.
validated.audio: Raw sample differences retained. Both idle captures pass game-audio signal and recording-quality checks. Selection recording limits are retained in native notes and qualification; no human audibility approval claimed.
validated.native: Japanese Chikorita, Cyndaquil and Totodile previews, both rotation directions, inspect/cancel/confirm and final Chikorita choice were exercised. Sampled images and the direct framebuffer endpoint show intact models/text and return to the lab. The selection recording lost one OBS encoded frame (zero render drops, continuous decoded timestamps); it is used only for visual checkpoints, not selection cadence or audio equivalence. Separate idle captures passed recording quality and establish unchanged measured light cadence.
validated.save: Normal Save, soft-reset Continue and fresh-process cold Continue/party passed
validated.unrelated: Fresh-process post-save lab and party input replay does not enter the starter scene. Shared delivery/static proof and German unrelated software replay are reused; no separate Japanese software collateral pair or full playthrough is claimed.
validated.scope: Starter idle/active selection, adjacent lab, normal Save, soft reset and cold-load/party. The final cold input replay does not load the starter scene.
validated.checkpoint_provenance: Retained verified USA native pre-starter checkpoint, imported for Japanese target-scene A/B and compatibility only; not independent Japanese new-game progression.

patches.notes: Guarded regional transfer of the accepted48-byte terrain visibility gate. Reuses existing game query and immutable transforms; no scratch, HPS service, RTL or original-ROM write. Native scope is a fixed New Bark plaza view with documented imported own-title save. Default disabled; explicit private catalog selection required.

validated.static: Exact identity, original48 Thumb bytes, relocated calls/literals and56 constant/pointer bytes guarded. Full reached visibility-query direct-flow closure matches281 instructions and51 edges; changed globals retain BSS-relative offsets.
validated.reference: All3600 target screen pairs, initial1800 home/boot pairs and save bytes match cumulative decoded delivery. Two earlier top hashes differ at2025/2031 during scene brightening and one bottom hash at3187 during menu brightening; these do not match adjacent control hashes within two frames. Seven paired full-resolution checkpoints and retained transition thumbnails preserve the expected scene. Raw RAM/audio/timing differences retained; not full-run bit-exactness or human approval.
validated.native: Stock1GHz cold original/candidate fixed-plaza capture; house entry, Bag, return outdoors, normal Save, soft-reset Continue, fresh-process cold field/Bag and unchanged save passed. Four save-block payload CRCs valid.
validated.scope: New Bark Town, home and Bag only. No independent regional new-game progression, battle/whole-game or human audiovisual approval. Persistent core save states unsupported.

gain.scope: One30-second verified cold-start window per arm at stock1GHz; publications are not unique animation FPS, cycle counts or whole-game speed. Decoded delivery separately compared in the reference replay; no native decoded-control window or confidence interval claimed.
